newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi legislator appointed as auditor.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi legislator appointed as auditor.

text.p: State Rep. Phil Bryant has been chosen by Gov. Kirk Fordice as Mississippi's new state auditor.

Bryant was selected Wednesday to replace auditor Steve Patterson, who resigned last week after agreeing to plead guilty to a misdemeanor charge of filing a false affidavit to avoid paying an auto license fee.
Bryant, 41, is a Republican from Brandon serving his second term in the Mississippi House. He is an insurance fraud investigator and a former sheriff's deputy.
He will oversee audits of state agencies and local governments, initiate investigations in allegations of misspending and monitor the state accounting system.
